items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. We used to work together.

ctx.x: Well listen, big time may be one thing but between performers, I mean you know, there are a whole lot of performers that know where they got things from, you know? Well here's a guy that was big but never appealed to me. I just wondered what you'd say, and that's Billy Daniels.
Oh, well I used to like Billy Daniels.
